/gzung dang 'dzin pa las grol ba'i// ye shes mngon du ma byas pa// de srid kun rdzob dam pa'i don// zung du 'brel bar 'dis rtogs shog /dam pa'i don yang mtshan 'dzin las// ji srid ma grol de srid du// kun rdzob nyid las ma 'das phyir// sgyu mar 'dzin pa las grol shog /mtshan 'dzin ma lus ye shes kyi// me chen 'bar bas sregs zin nas// kun rdzob snang ba ci shar yang*// don dam kho nar 'dis rtogs shog /dam pa'i don la mtshan 'dzin gyi// spros pa ma lus bkag shul du// don dam bden gcig ye shes la// rnam rol snang tshogs du 'char shog /gsum pa ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnam par bshad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod bdun pa zhes kyang bya/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa zhes kyang bya/ rang gzhan grub mtha'i shan 'byed drug cu rtsa gsum pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos tshul 'di la lhag par mos shing nyams su len pa'i bshes gnyen gu ge sha waṃ pa rnam rgyal grags pa bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ rje bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa yab sras rnam pa lnga las/ 'phags skor gyi dbang lung bshad pa man ngag rnams rdzogs par thos shing*/ rgyal sras kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i zhal snga nas/ ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang lung nye bar thob pa'i bka' drin gyis/ rje btsun khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi dgongs pa zab mo yongs su gang bar gyur cig pa'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag nas/ rang lo don bdun pa shing pho bya ba'i cho 'phrul can gyi yar tshes dga' ba gsum pa la thub bstan gser mdog can gyi chos grwa chen por rdzogs par grub pa'i/ yi ge pa ni bsod nams ye shes lhun grub pa'o// //maṅga laṃ/

bha wantu// ༈ //dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnam bshad kyi rang lugs 'jog mtshams so bdun pa zhes bya ba dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs nyid la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nges don mthar thug ni bden gnyis zung 'jug tu nges/ zung 'jug gi go don gnyis su med par nges/ gnyis med kyi go don don dam pa'i bden pa gcig pur nges/ gcig pu de blo'i yul las 'das pa dbu ma thal rang gi lugs te 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs/ gcig pu de so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi myong byar bzhed pa rnam rdzun dbu ma'i lugs te rje btsun byams pas gsungs/ gcig pu de'i ngos 'dzin zhen blos dag pa'i rang bzhin lhan skyes la bzhed pa sngags kyi dbu ma'i lugs te rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ de la ldog pas phye na rang bzhin rnam dag gzhi dus kyi dbu ma dang*/ glo bur rnam dag 'bras dus kyi dang*/ phyogs res dag pa lam dus kyi dang gsum yod kyang*/ rtogs byed kyi thabs sngags lam gyis ma byas na sngags kyi dbu mar mi rung*/ phar phyin pa'i lung rigs kyis phu thag bcad zer ba'i dbu ma de don spyi dang gzhan sel tsam las ma 'das/ sngags lam du kun rdzob rang stong gi lta ba dang don dam gzhan stong gi stong nyid gang yin kyang ye shes nyid la ngos 'dzin dgos/ ye shes de'i dngos po rang stong du khas blangs na sngags kyi nyams len 'jig pas na/ theg pa chen po'i dbu ma gnyis kyi rang lugs so sor shan phyed dgos so// zhes bya ba ni bcu tshan dang po'o// thal rang gi dbu mar ni chos gang yang gdod ma nas yod ma myong*/ de'i tshe thos bsam gyi rigs pas btsal bas mi rnyed/ de'i phyir gang yang yod pa ma yin/ med pa'ang min/ yod med gnyis ka ma yin pa ni yod med gnyis ka yin pa la ltos nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ phyogs gcig khas mi len pa'i tshe 'gal zla gcig shos kyang khas mi len/

de lta bu'i mtha' bral de rtogs pa'i mngon sum mi srid/ sgra rtog gis yul du gang byas gzhan sel las ma 'das pa'i phyir don dam bden par mi rung*/ tha snyad du don dam bden pa'i mtshan gzhir gang gzung ba des don dam bden pa'i go mi chod/ de lta bu'i mtha' bral de sngags lam gyi tshe mtshan 'dzin sel byed du rung yang mnyam gzhag nyams len la sbyar na skyed rdzogs kyi lam 'jig par byed/ thal rang gi lta ba'i 'jog tshul med par dgag pa nyid du gnas/ dbang bzhi pa'i lta bas thal rang pa'i mtha' bral yul du byed na mtshan mar 'dzin pa las ma 'das so// zhes bya ba ni bcu tshan gnyis pa'o// gsang sngags bla med kyi brjod bya don gyi rgyud ni/ gzhi gdod ma nas yod pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa de la ngos 'dzin/ ming gi rnam grangs dang po'i sangs rgyas/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po chos dbyings ye shes dang e waṃ zhes bya/ 'di ni yul can spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar 'chad kyi yul gyi spros bral du mi 'chad/ skyed rdzogs mtha' dag gi sgrub gzhi dang sgrub pa po 'di las gzhan na med cing*/ spang bya mtha' dag gi sbyang gzhi dang gnas dang yon tan mtha' dag dbyer med du 'jug pa'i gzhi 'di kho nar nges/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po la btags pa'i gang zag sgrub pa por khas blangs na mu stegs dang khyad med du song*/ sbyang gzhi sbyong ba dang spang bya spong ba'i khyad par shes na mthar thug gi spangs rtogs mngon du byed tshul go nus/ zag bcas kyi phung sogs su snang ba'i rnam rig las ma gtogs pa'i phung sogs kyi dngos po khas mi len pa de'i tshe phyir blta dri ma'i cha nas sbyang bya dang*/ nang blta rang rig gi cha nas sbyang gzhir 'jog pa'i shan phyed dgos/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam gyis tshe gcig la sangs rgyas 'grub pa 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi'i lus rten skyon dang bral ba kho nar nges/

de ltar sangs rgyas pa'i tshe zhing de sangs rgyas rang dang sa bcu pa'i byang sems kyi rang snang la 'og min kho nar nges/ chos dang 'khor gyi nges pa gdul bya gzhan snang la 'byed/ rang re'i ston pa 'od gsal gyi rim pas de ma thag tu sangs rgyas par bshad pa de sgyu ma'i sku mthar phyin pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs zin pa lhan cig par byung ba la dgongs so// zhes bya ba ni bcu tshan gsum pa'o// rdo rje'i theg par ni gzhi 'bras gnyis su don dam pa'i bden pa 'ba' zhig yod kyi gcig shos yod par mi 'chad cing dbu ma thal 'gyur bas ni dus der de yang mi 'dod kyi stong nyid 'ba' zhig pa'o zhes 'chad/ lugs de gnyis kas kyang*/ ji srid glo bur ba gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags ma spangs pa de srid du kun rdzob tu bden pa dag ni ma brtags gcig pur nyams dga' ba nyid du khas len cing de'i 'bras bu bsod nams las ni gzhan snang la longs sku'i snang ba 'char/ lugs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu ma ni sgrub pa'i gzhi don dam pa las bsgrubs pa yin kyang yul can rtog par song ba'i dbang gis kun rdzob bden par 'chad dgos/ rtog pa de tsam zhig 'od gsal ba'i mes bsregs pa na sgyu ma ni zung 'jug don dam pa'i bden pa 'ba' zhig par lhun gyis grub/ skyed rdzogs kyi sgrub pa po chos dbyings ye shes nyid de dag gi lhar 'char ba yin gyi/ lha'i gzung rnam 'char mkhan gyi sgrub pa po'i rtog pa logs na yod zer ba 'khrul/ sangs rgyas kyi sems can gyi sems la kun rdzob kyi 'char tshul mkhyen pa ni sems can de dag gi rang snang las yin gyi/ rnam shes kyi dngos po snang bar 'chad pa ma yin/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gsung nas sangs rgyas dang sems can rgyud gcig pa nyid du 'chad pa de/ shes bya mtha' dag pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi ye shes gcig nyid yin pa la dgongs te/

de'i rgyu mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ji snyed pa sems can la 'jug tu rung ba yin/ zhes bya ba ni grub pa'i don bdun mtshan gcig kha bskang ste bshad pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnam bshad rin po che'i gter mdzod bdun pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi brjod bya'i don gyi rnam grangs brgya tham pa go bde bar ngos gzung ba yin te/ rnam bshad dkyus ma nyid kyi nang na bod snga ma dang phyi ma zhes pa'i tshig gis zin pa drug cu re gsum yod do// smras pa/ rang gzhan grub mtha' so so ba'i// skye mched cha shas ma nyams pa// gsal por 'char ba'i dngul dkar gyi// me long g.ya' dang sgrib bral ba// lta 'dod yod dam phyis 'byon pa'i// sbyangs ldan rnam dpyod gsal po dang*// zhen pas zhugs min 'gas mthong na// thal mo lan brgyar sbyor min nam// dbu ma'i gzhung lugs log blo yis// sbyar ba'i gzan zer 'phyor chas su// byed pos rang gzhan gsang sngags kyi// shan 'byed zer ba gad mo'i gnas// 'dir bshad nyung ngu'i lde mig gis// gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos kyi sgo// brgya phrag 'byed do yid ches par// bzhed na gzhung lugs mang du ltos// zhes kyang rjes su sbyar ba yin// shu bhaṃ// swa sti/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs ye shes// mi phyed gsang kun 'dus pa'i dngos// ya mtshan sgyu ma'i gar gyis ni// grub pa ma lus sbyin mdzad po// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i phyogs re tsam// bzung bas kun la bsnyengs bral zhes// 'phags yul grags pa'i rnga sgra can// kun gyi gtsug rgyan nor bus len// gangs can ljongs su lha btsan po'i// dad pa'i pho nyas spyan 'drongs pa// snga 'gyur theg pa'i lam srol dang*// phyis 'gyur kun gyi'ang thog mar byon// de nas mar 'gos lo tsā yi// g.yo med shing rtas 'dir drangs pa// kun tshang mdzod bzung rin chen grub// de sras gzhon nus ye shes kyi// mtshan can la 'phos srol kun dang*// kha che pa las phyis byon pa'i// dbang dang gdams pa kun tshang ba// rab bzung chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang bsgyur kun dga'i nyi ma yis// gsang 'dus bstan pa'i thun mtshams yang*// nyin byed bzang por mdzad gang gis// gangs can ljongs su phyis 'byon pa'i// mang thos grags pa gsal ldan 'ga'// sngags gzhung kun las 'dus pa'i lam// khyad 'don bsgrub pa'i dal ba yis// theg chen gzhung kun ma bshad dang*// bshad ches pa dang legs par ni// bshad las gzhan du brtsams gzigs nas// kun gyi shan 'byed 'khrul med du// rgyas par mdzad do lhag ma'i khur// dngos slob rnam dpyod thos pa can// kun la gzhag phyir gang 'dis kyang*// sngon rabs rgyud pa'i gzhung btsugs nas// rin chen gter mdzod bdun gyi dngos// zhal mthong stsol ba'i rnam thar sgo// nyi shu rtsa gcig 'dir phye bas// phyis byung gtam gyi sgo brgya shes// sgo mangs de dag gang phye yang*// 'dus pa'i gtsug lag khang mi mthong*// rje btsun gong ma'i gzhung 'dzugs zhes// dus 'dir zer ba gzhan mang pos// 'bel gtam gcig nas gsum sbrel tshe// gzhan zer gtam gyi sgor zhugs nas// gtam de rang gzhung rgyan du 'dzin// dpyod can thos ldan 'ga' yod dam// rang gzhan grub mtha'i sgo dbye ba// mtshar du dngar ba'i bstan bcos 'di// par du gang grub bdag po'i rkyen// bstan 'dzin bkra shis rgyal mo'i mtshan// par shing gting khebs rdzong chen pas// mdzad do 'dri po bsrungs ma dpal// mkhas pa'i grags thob chos dpal ldan// don kun grub dang gu ru skyabs// chos 'di par du legs grub pa// skabs der yon gyi bdag po mchog

/chab srid 'jam dar rgyas pa dang*// dbu rmog gong nas gong btsan shog /rgyu tshogs sbyor dang sgo gsum gyi// rig byed sgrin 'grus rnam dag pa// kun la mchog dang thun mong gi /grub pa'i dngos kun deng 'dir stsol// //swa sti/ phyi nang gzhan gsum 'byor pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos rin chen gter mdzod gsum pa ces bya ba bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod pa ma yin mod// phyi nang gzhan gsum zhes bya ba// bden pa gnyis las rab tu phyed// las dang nyon mongs las byung pa'i// phyi nang kun rdzob bden pa ste// gzhan ni rang bzhin glo bur gyis// rnam dag don dam bden pa'o// thog mar phyi nang sbyar bshad nas// de dang gzhan sbyor tshul rjes 'chad// 'jig rten mu med la sogs pa// phyi'i dbang gis nang byung zhes// zer mod nang las phyi 'byung bar// theg chen pa rnams phal cher mthun// de yang kun gzhi'i steng du ni// 'khor ba'i phyogs kyis chos rnams kyi// sa bon bsags pa smin pa las// khams drug ldan pa'i skyes bu byung*// de yang mi nyid kyis dbang byas// mi lus 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i// dpangs las 'jig rten 'bum phrag bzhi// rgal tshigs ngo bor snang ba yi// bag chags smin las ri rab kyang*// snang ngo mgo 'og lus tshud pa'i// don snod brten par bcas pa yi// bag chags dbang las ri mtsho gling*// drug tshan gsum po'ang sbas te snang*// lus la rtsa'i gtso mo gsum// gnas pas 'khor 'das gnyis 'byung zhing*// 'khor ba gzung dang 'dzin pa ste// ro rkyang gnyis su snang las byung*// gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis spangs pa'i// dbu ma mya ngan 'das pa ste// kun gzhi'i ye shes zhes bya ba// chos kyi dbyings dang don gcig bzhed// ro rkyang dag tu rlung rgyu ba// phyi nang stong dang brgyad brgya re// phan tshun 'pho ba bcu gnyis so// drug tshan gnyis su phye byas nas// nang du 'pho chen bcu gnyis las// phyi ru sa dum bcu gnyis dang*// nam mkha' la yang khyim bcu gnyis// gzhan du bden don rnam bcu gnyis// gzung 'dzin rlung rnams phyir rgyu bas// gza' rnams shar du gdong bltas nas// g.yas min du rgyu khyim rnams la// rim pa bzhin du longs spyod pas// snod kyi 'jig rten ngo mtshar bar// byed ngo nyi ma'i bgrod pa gnyis// nang gi drug tshan gnyis las byung*// re re la'ang khyim zla ni// drug drug nges par tshang yod pa// 'pho chen re la las kyi rlung*// stong dang brgyad brgya nges par yang*// tshang dgos pa'i rgyu las byung*// nyi ma khyim du bsdad pa yi// rgyu las dpyid dbyar ston dgun bzhi// byung nas snod rnams rgyas byed cing*// longs spyod tshogs rnams smin par byed// zla ba'i bgrod pa'ang nyi ma dang*// 'dra ste nang gi rgyu ba'i dbang*// yin mod zla bas tshes zla gcig

/nyi mas khyim lor 'khor dgos pa// zla bas de ltar 'khor ba ci// zhe na zla ba'i 'phel 'grib cha// rdzogs pa myur zhing dus kyi cha// rdzogs pa bul ste de yang ni// nang gi zla ba yar tshes la// 'dzin pa'i lam du 'phel gyur nas// spyi bor haṃ la thim pa dang*// mar ngo la ni gzung ba yi// lam du zhugs nas 'gribs gyur pa// rdul la rdzogs par thim pa rnams// tshes zla gcig la byung phyir dang*// nang rdul cha shas bcu gnyis po// rdzogs la khyim zla bcu gnyis re// dgos so mngal gyi bcu dang ni// bcas pa'i gnyis dang bcas nas so// 'o na bu mo bcu gnyis mar// rdul mtha' rdzogs par ci zhe na// skabs der rdul gyis khu ba ni// 'dzin par nus pa'i dbang du byas// dper na skyes pa'i bcu drug lor// zla ba 'dor nus bshad de bzhin// nyi ma'i rang 'gros dus chen bzhir// bya bas zla bas ci zhe na// dus re re la ra 'bring sogs// gsum po zla ba'i nya skar la// byung ngo tshes zla bcu gnyis po// rdzogs tshe nya skar bcu gnyis 'grig /nang du khu rdul mi ldan na// phyi ru nyi zla 'char mi 'gyur// sum mdo'i raṃ dang spyi bo'i haṃ// med na rta gdong 'bar ba dang*// byang du bsil ba'i ri mi snang*// nyi ma'i gdung byed bsil ri la// thug pas drod chen 'bar ba yang*// nang gi nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las// yin te rta gdong 'bar ba'i 'od// nyi mar phog pas mtsho khol ba// sum mdo'i raṃ las lte ba'i me// sbar te mgrin pa'i chu khol ba// phan tshun ltos pa'i rten 'brel lo// 'o na nang gi nyi ma ni// lus kyi smad na gnas pa'i phyir// phyi'i nyi ma ri rab kyi// thod dang mnyam par 'char ba ci// zhe na thabs shes rnal 'byor las// lugs ldog dga' ba bzhi'i tshe// rdul yang spyi bo'i zla ba dang*// mnyam par rgyu ba'i rten 'brel las// yin no res 'ga' nyi ma ni// dpag tshad brgyad khri las mtho zhing*// res 'ga' bdun khri las kyang dma'// nang gi khu rngul gyen thur du// byed las phyi'i nyi zla yang*// de ltar byed cing chags chen dang*// chags bral nyid du byed pa'o// tshes lo re la nyi zla gnyis// kha sbyor byed pa bcu gnyis la// lhag pa mi 'byung nya skar yang*// bcu gnyis las lhag mi 'byung ngo*// gzhon nu ma la de 'dra'i lo// dang po dga' ba'i dga' nyid dus// nas tsam bcu drug lo lon tshe// lhan cig skyes pa'i lhan skyes nyid// mngon du byed pa'i dus yin no// de bzhin gzhan la'ang bcu gnyis lor// rdul gyis zla ba 'dzin nus pa// byung tshe bden don bcu gnyis po// mngon du byed par nus yin no// byed pas khyim rnams g.yas su rgyu// nyi zla'i rang 'gros shar dang ni// lho nas byang dang byang nas lho// steng nas 'og tu 'gro byed mod// khyim 'gros kho nas nub tu rgyu// de'i byed pas nyin mtshan du// snang phyir skyes bu'i lus stobs dang*// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel 'grib tu// byed pas rten 'brel sna tshogs 'byung*// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis// ri rab 'khor thebs sum brgya dang*// drug bcu re lnga tshang ba na// khyim la gcig tu 'jog pa yin// rgyu skar 'char dus de snyed la// nyi ma'i 'char dus sum brgya dang*// drug bcu las lhag yod ma yin// zla 'char sum brgya nga bzhi'o// rtsis mkhan phal cher de ring gi

/nyi shar ba de nyin zhag gcig /yin pas khyim lo gcig tshang bar// nyin zhag sum brgya re lnga dgos// zer ba brdzun no nyin re bzhin// rgyu skar 'char ba'i dus tshod las// nyi ma 'char ba je ring du// song bar mngon sum gyis grub pas// nyin zhag tshad de 'thad ma yin// smin drug shar nas 'char gyis bar// tshad can gcig tu nges pa ni// nyin zhag re re'i tshad yin te// nyi ma shar nas 'char ka'i bar// snga ma de las cung lhag pa// khyim zhag re re'i tshad du bya// tshes zhag lkog tu gyur mod kyang*// zla ba'i 'phel 'grib sum cu po// rdzogs tshe tshes zla gcig tu tshang*// mngon par yud tsam sum cu la// nyin zhag gcig tu bshad pa yang*// skar ma'i 'char tshul dbang btsan pa// yin de nyi ma la bshad na// yud tsam sum cu las lhag 'gyur// bcu gnyis khyim gyi 'gro tshul las// sa la dus chen rnams bzhi dang*// tshes zla bcu gnyis 'byung ba yang*// phan tshun ltos pa'i rten 'brel te// dus bzhin nyi ma'i rang 'gros dang*// nyin mtshan nyi ma'i khyim 'gros las// byung ngo nya skar bcu gnyis po// zla ba kho na'i rang 'gros kyis// byas so zla bas mtshan 'khyol ba// khyim 'gros dbang las byung ba yin// 'dzam gling dbus mar nag pa yis// mtshan 'khyol byed pa'i tshes bco lnga// 'dzam gling shar mar sa ga yis// mtshan skyel byed pa'i bcu gcig dang*// 'dzam gling nub mar dbo yis ni// mtshan skyel byed pa'i bcu drug tu// song ba sogs la dgongs pa'i tshig /dri med 'od la gsungs pa yin// sa'i dum bu bcu gnyis por// kla klo'i chos 'byung gnas pa'i lo// stong dang brgyad brgya gsungs pa yang*// las rlung rgyu ba'i grangs las byung*// rigs ldan drag pos kla klo'i chos// bcom nas rang gi bstan pa'i tshang*// gsungs pa mi 'gyur bde ba ni// stong dang brgyad brgya'i dbang las byung*// 'dir bshad yul snang ji snyed kun// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa// bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa// kho na'i rnam par shes pa la// snang ba'i dbang du byas yin gyi// spyi mthun las grub yin par mngon pa'i chos las gsungs// 'dir bshad rang sems kyis bsdus pa// yin phyir 'dir 'byung mngon pa dang*// mi mthun rtsod pa'i go skabs bral// de nas gzhan gyi rnam gzhag ni// cung zad rgyas par bshad bya ba// gzhi dus rang bzhin gyis grub dang*// lam dus sbyangs pa las byung ngo*// dang po khams drug ldan pa yis// dbu ma rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i// dbang las sgra can lus dang ni// mgo dang 'jug tu snang ba 'char// mgo bo byang sems chu'i rang bzhin// 'jug ma dus me rdul gyi de// lus ni thog med gzung 'dzin dang*// bral ba nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// sgra can rang bzhin mya ngan las// 'das phyir khyim du mi 'jug cing*// khyim 'gros bshad pa 'chad mi nus// nang du sgra can lus dbang gi

/phyi ru nam mkha'i khams dang ni// srid gsum bral ba'i 'du shes 'byung*// dbu ma'i lam du nyon mongs can// 'jug pa yod ma yin mod kyi// kun gzhi'i ye shes rnams smin cha// lhag pa'i rten dang brten par gnas// kun gzhi'i ye shes las rlung gi /bskyod par nus pa las yin mod// bag chags rlung gis g.yos pa las// rnam par smin la ngar 'dzin byung*// ngar 'dzin pa dang las kyi rlung*// bdag po rkyen du gyur pa las// don dang sems can rnam rig rgyu// snang bas rnam par shes pa skye// ye shes ma gtogs rnam rig ni// thams cad 'khrul pa'i snang ba ste// las rlung rgyu ba kun khegs pa'i// snod bcud ma lus chos dbyings su// ro gcig gyur pa gang de nyid// rim pa gnyis po bsgrubs pa'i gzhi// gnyis pa sbyangs pa las gyur ni// nang gi dbang las phyi byung ba// sbyong byed skyed pa'i rim pa ste// nang nyid sbyong ba rdzogs rim mo// thog mar stong pa nyid bsams nas// phyi nang gzung 'dzin kun bral ba'i// rten dang brten par bcas pa yi// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal gdab bo// gsal snang de la rtog pa dang*// rtog med gsal ba mthar phyin gnyis// gnyis po zung du 'brel ba yi// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed pa dang*// zung du ma 'brel so so bas// sbyangs gzhi sbyong bar nus ma yin// rtog pa'i bskyed rim sngon song nas// sor bsdud dus su dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs gsal ba// de ni bskyed pa'i rim pa yi// mchog yin zer na bsam gtan gyi// yan lag rnams dang ma bral bar// rgyun tu goms par bya yin gyi// lung bstan min dang ma dag pa'i// sbyang ba de de ma yin mod// sbyang gzhi sbyong bar mi nus phyir// rgyun du bsgom par bya ba yin// 'on kyang der snang de gzhan gyis// stong bar shes las gang zag dang*// chos su 'dzin pa'i phyogs gcig sel// lugs 'dir rdzogs rim gyi gtso bo// 'gyur med bde ba chen po dang*// spang bya'i gtso bo 'pho ba yis// bag chags nyid las gang bshad pa// khams drug ldan pa'i skyes bu'i lus// tshe 'dir zag pa zad byed pa'i// thabs yin bdag 'dzin gnyis po yi// gnyen po logs su bsam par bya// 'bras dus gzhan zhes bya ba ni// bcu gnyis sa'i dbang phyug ste// 'pho chen ma lus 'gags pa'i phyir// ma dag snang ba mi 'char mod// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la sogs pa// gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste// sna tshogs gzugs rnams 'chang ba'i dpal// gzugs brnyan ma lus 'char ba po// dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas rang snang gi

/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te// gzhan snang gzugs kyi sku gang nyid// gzhan sems kyis bsdus so// // ༄// swa sti/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas// de nas phar phyin theg par yang*// phyi nang gzhan zhes bya ba yi// rnam gzhag 'chad tshul de bsam bya// phyi'i dbang gis nang 'byung zhing*// nang gi rnam shes 'khor bcas pa// kho nar 'dod de nyan thos pa'i// lugs yin theg chen gzhung na med// nang gi dbang gis phyi 'byung zhing*// nang la rnam shes ye shes dang*// phyi la chos dang gang zag tu// 'byed pa theg chen pa kun mthun// kun tu brtags pa phyi yin te// gzhan gyi dbang ni nang nyid dang*// gdod nas yongs su grub pa ni// gnyis med gzhan zhes bya bar 'chad// gzhan gyis dbang las gang byung ba'i// chos dang gang zag rnams kun brtags// gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi// khams gsum par snang de gzhan dbang*// de la chos dang gang zag zhes// btags pa'i yod pa de dngos med// rnam shes dngos po de bden zhes// sems tsam pa'i 'dod pa ste// gnyis med ye shes de bden pa// chos 'khor gsum pa'i dbu mar 'dod// 'dir ni phyi nang gzhan ji snyed// chos kyi dbyings las byung pa ste// phyi dang nang ni glo bur du// 'bras rung tshul du byung ba ste// rnam snang chos ni gsar byung yang*// chos kyi dbyings dang dbye ba med// chos dbyings ngo shes byed tshul la// gzhung du man ngag lugs gnyis byung*// dang po gzung 'dzin gnyis med du// thos bsam bsgom pa las yin te// phyi ma sems kyi ngo bo la// blta tshul 'khrul pa med las rnyed// dang po nyid nas rtog med du// skye ba man ngag lugs yin te// thos bsam sgom byung las dang po// thog mar rtog pa nyid du skye// chos kyi dbyings la nyon mongs dang*// rnam rtog bag chags 'gags pa las// gnas pa kun gzhi'i sa bon cha// smin pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes dngos// ma 'ongs dus su smin gyur pa'i// sa bon da lta ba nyid dang*// sngon dus bag chags 'dir smin pa// de dag la 'dir de skad brjod// gdod ma'i ye shes gcig nyid la// gnyen po rnam byang ye shes dang*// spang bya bag chags ma smin gsum// gnas la khyad par med dus su'ang*// goms byed blo yis phyogs 'dzin pas// gnyen pos spang bya spong bar nus// spang bya'i bag chags da ltar bas// ma smin la sogs ma 'ongs pa// skye ba'i nus pa 'jog byed kyi// skyes zin 'das dang da ltar ba// gnyen po spong tshul phar phyin gyi// theg par bshad pa yod ma yin// sngags su snod bcud grub zin pa'i// kun rdzob ngo bo stong nyid du// sbyangs nas don dam ye shes kyi// ngo bo lha ru grub pa na// rnam smin grub zin da ltar ba// spong ba'i thabs mkhas bshad pa yin// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o//

// ༄// dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// 'pho ba'i bag chags 'khor ba yi// rtsa bar bshad tshe dgra bcom pas// de spang phyir na de yang ni// spangs par thal zhes zer ba'i lan// 'dod pa nyid do mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba thog par thal zhe na// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba nyon mongs pa// ched du gnyer nas spong ba dang*// de mi spong bar mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba lam du byas pa las// 'khor bar mi 'gyur chad pa yi// myang 'das su'ang mi 'gyur ba'i// 'gyur med bde chen lam byed pa// theg pa mchog gi khyad chos so// 'khor ba ched du mi spong na// 'pho ba'i bag chags ched du ni// gnyer nas spong ba 'gal zhe na// sgrub pa po yi rnam smin lus// zas lus kyi rgyur 'gyur ba// spong bar byed kyi ma 'ongs pa'i// 'khor ba spong ba ma yin no// 'pho ba'i bag chags mi spong ba'i// mi 'gyur bde ba re re nas// thog mar mngon du byed pa yi// sad byed rkyen la 'pho ba'i yang*// bag chags med mi rung bshad phyir// de 'dra ba la 'gal ba med// mdor na 'pho ba'i bag chags ni// 'phos pa 'gyur med bde chen gyi// gegs yin de'i bag chags tsam// 'gyur med bde ba chen po ni// 'dren byed de ma thag pa'i rkyen// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// rin chen gter mdzod gsum 'byed pa'i// rin chen lde mig rnam gsum po// rin chen spungs par dran gsos nas// rin chen gling du sbyar ba'o// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ// khyab bdag 'khor lo sgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal nas ni gsang sngags su// 'jug pa'i sgo gsum rnam 'byed ces// bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di 'chad do// gsang sngags la 'jug gegs dang ni// sgrib par byed pa'i sgo gsum po// dwang du len pa'i gsang sngags pa// rnams la yin lugs lam bstan bya// kun rdzob tshad mas grub pa dang*// rnam shes tshad mar 'dod pa dang*// phung por btags pa'i nga tsam zhig

/thar pa'i rten du 'dod pa gsum// mun pa'i sgo yin de gsal na// gsang sngags lam chen mthong bar 'gyur// kun rdzob rang rang ngo bo yis// stong pa'i rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos// kun rdzob bden pa'i sgo bcom na// bskyed pa'i rim pa ngang gis 'char// kun rdzob ma dag snang ba dang*// dag snang lha'i rten brten pa// gnas khang gcig tu gnas gyur na// stong pa'i ngang las zer ba 'gal// zhing sbyangs pa las ma dag pa'i// snang ba 'char na zhing sbyangs par// 'gal dang rje btsun byams pa yis// mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir// zhes gsungs pa dang thogs med kyi// mi rtog ye shes rgyu ba la// don kun snang ba med pa'i phyir// don med khong du chud bya zhes// gsungs pa shing rta'i srol chen yin// gdod nas yod ma myong ba yis// kun rdzob bden pa bsal zin pa'i// 'og tu gdod nas grub pa yi// ye shes las ni gsang sngags kyi// kun rdzob mtha' dag bsgrub par bya// rnam shes dang ni ye shes kyi// dbye ba so sor mi phyed pa// gang 'di dag gis gsang sngags kyi// lam chen mi shes mun pas bsgribs// gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyi// snang ba'i rnam rig gang byung ba// de la rnam shes zhes zer gyis// de der ye shes srid pa yin// lhan skyes ye shes rdo rje yis// rnam shes 'khrul pa'i sgo bcag nas// rgyud gsum po dang rdzogs rim gyi// ye shes ngang gis 'char bar 'gyur// mdor na rnam shes tshad ma ni// byams pa'i chos kyi dbu ma nas// gsang sngags bla med dbu ma'i bar// gang du yang ni gsungs pa med// bdag med rtogs pa'i rdo rje yis// bdag tu lta ba'i sgo bcom na// sngags kyi bsgrub gzhi ma lus pa// dam pa'i bdag tu shes par 'gyur// de de gang la bya zhe na// gsang sngags nyams len byed kun gyi// ye shes rdo rje nga yin zhes// lan brgyar 'don pa de dang ni// 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// zhes sogs kyis bstan rang bzhin gyi// chos sku nyid la 'chad pa yin// chos sku ngar 'dzin yul las ni// 'das phyir nga nyid min pa la// nga'i tha snyad byas pa ni// bdag dam pa'i pha rol phyin// 'o na mu stegs pa'i bdag

/btags yod dang ni sangs rgyas pa'i// dam pa'i bdag ni rdzas yod phyir// bdag 'dzin spang bar dka' zhe na// dam pa'i bdag ni sgra rtog gi /yul min de yul byed pa yi// ye shes kyis kyang de der ni// zhen pa med phyir spang bya min// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ// khyab bdag 'khor lo sgyur rgyal la// phyag 'tshal gsang sngags la 'jug pa'i// lan gsum gsal bar shes nas ni// nyams len gnas la gdeng thob 'gyur// gzung ba'i lam dang 'dzin pa'i lam// dbu ma'i lam dang rnam pa gsum// gzung 'dzin lam dang gnyis med lam// gnyis bsres lam dang rnam pa gsum// rnam shes lam dang ye shes lam// zung 'brel lam dang rnam pa gsum// 'khor ba'i lam dang myang 'das lam// mi gnas lam dang rnam pa gsum// zhi gnas lam dang lhag mthong lam// zung 'jug lam dang rnam pa gsum// sngags su ma zad theg chen pa// kun la mkho ba 'di bshad bya// gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes ni// dbu ma'i lam las gzhan mi 'jug /kun gzhi bag chags rnam smin cha// ye shes min mod dbu mar gnas// rnam smin des bskyed las kyi rlung*// gzung ba'i lam du zhugs gyur pas// bdag dang don gyi snang ba 'char// 'dzin pa'i lam du zhugs gyur pas// rnam rig nyid du snang ba 'char// rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun po'i// snang cha bdag dang chos su 'du// gnyis po rang rang ngo bo yis// stong phyir bdag med gnyis bshad do// de med pas na der snang ba'i// rnam par shes kyang yod ma yin// tshogs bdun gyis bsdus gzung 'dzin kun// kun rdzob bden no kun gzhi yi// rnam smin gcig tu tha snyad kyi// dus su don dam bden yin mod// chad cing nyin mtshan sbyor ba'i phyir// rnam par dag pa'i dmigs pa min// rnam par smin las ma byung ba'i// 'khor ba zhes pa yod min zhing*// bag chags las ni ma byung ba'i// rnam par smin pa'ang yod ma yin// rnam smin bag chags ji snyed kyang*// chos kyi dbyings las ma byung med// gnas skabs sgrib pa kun gyi gnas// rnam par smin yin mthar thug gi

/gnas ni chos dbyings kho na'o// gnas nyid na'ang 'bral rung phyir// gnas gyur pa ni 'thad pa yin// dbu ma gnas pa'i kun gzhi ni// gzung 'dzin lam du ma zhugs phyir// yang dag min rtog ma yin zhing*// 'phral gyis 'khrul rgyus ma bslad kyang*// phugs kyi 'khrul pa'i ngo bo nyid// yin phyir mngon sum du mi 'dod// dbu ma'i nang du gnas pa'i phyir// log shes nyid du'ang mi 'dod do// dgra bcom nyid na de zlog par// bshad pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i// sa bon yin phyir rnam smin ni// 'chi srid bar du rgyun mi chad// lhag med dus su shes sgrib kyi// sa bon yod dang med ces pa// dus der dbyings rig yod med lugs// rnam smin gnyen po da ltar bas// spong bar phar phyin pa la med// rnam smin gong nas gong 'phel ba'i// tshe sring byed pa'i thabs der bshad// gsum tshan gnyis pa gzung 'dzin lam// yang dag ma yin kun rtog dang*// sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ni// gang du rgyu ba'i lam yin mod// gzugs med sogs la las kyi rlung*// med phyir mtshan 'dzin rtog pa yi// bag chags sad par byed pa'i rkyen// yid byed snga ma kho na'o// gzung 'dzin la yang der snang dang*// der zhen gnyis su 'byed yod kyi// der snang rgyun mtha'i bar du ste// der zhen sa brgyad pa nas dag /gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i lam// gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes dang*// gsar du bslangs pa las byung pa// dang po shes rig kun las te// phyi ma mthong ba'i lam nas skye// gnyis bsres lam ni byang sems kyi// sgom lam rjes thob ye shes dang*// sngags las 'dod yon thams cad ni// ji ltar 'dod bzhin brten pa'i dus// ci phyir zhe na rnam shes kyi// yul du byed pa mi spong dang*// ye shes kyis ni gnyis med du// shes pa gnyis ka gzhi gcig phyir// gsum tshan gsum pa rnam shes lam// ma rig bag chags kyis bslad pa'i// shes pa kun yin thogs med nas// byung dang thos bsam gyis byung pa'o// las kyis rlung la zhon pa yi// yang dag ma yin kun rtog pa// 'dod pa'i rkyen la spong sla zhing*// 'gyur med bde chen bskyed par sla// gzung 'dzin rlung gis ma drangs pa'i// rnam shes zhi ba yin mod kyang*// gzugs med khams kyi rnam shes kyang*// sngags kyi lam du 'jug mi nus// ye shes lam ni phar phyin pa'i// lam du mnyam gzhag kho na dang*// sngags pas rjes kyi kun spyod kyang*// ye shes nyid las grub par bsam// gnyis bsres pa ni phyi dang nang*// gsang ba'i mchod pa lta bu ste// ye shes nyid la grub bsam kyang*// rnam shes snang ba mi 'dor bzhin// gsum tshan bzhi pa 'khor ba'i lam// 'dod dang srid pa'i sred pa ni// dang du len pa kun yin mod// bdag med pa dang thabs mkhas kyi// zin na lam gzhan du gyur srid// thar pa'i lam ni sred de dag

/bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis// 'bad nas spong ba dman pa'i lam// mi gnas pa la phar phyin dang*// gsang sngags gnyis las dang po ni// snying rjes 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu// sred pa dwang du len nyid do// sngags su stong nyid thabs mkhas dang*// 'brel ba'i chags pa lam byed kyis// tshe 'dir bde stong zung du 'jug /de bzhin 'pho ba'i bag chags kyang*// phal pas dwang du len pa dang*// nyan thos 'bad pas spong ba dang*// sngags pas lam du byed mod kyang*// bsgrub dus lo gsum phyogs gsum por// gzung 'dzin lam du thengs gcig tsam// 'phos nas 'khor ba pa nyid phyir// dus 'dir rdzogs sangs rgyas mi 'gyur// gsum tshan lnga pa zhi gnas lam// phyi nang gnyis ka la yod mod// bdag tu rmongs phyir mu stegs pa'i// zhi gnas 'das lam rten mi rung*// nang pa'i zhi gnas byang sems dang*// nyan thos dbye ba rnam pa gnyis// nyan thos zhi rags rnam can gyi// lhag mthong bsgrub pa'i rten nyid dam// zag med lam gyi rten nyid du// bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyis// zhi gnas tsam zhig thog mar bsgrub// de ni khams gsum thams cad la// chags bral lam gyi rten rung phyir// nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med ces bya// gong ma'i skye ba don gnyer dang*// mthong chos bde bar gnas 'dod pas// gong ma'i dngos gzhir 'jug pa'i tshe// 'og ma'i sa la chags bral bar// byed pa dman pa'i lugs yin mod// theg chen pa dang lhag mthong gi /nye bar bsdogs la ma reg par// rnam par thar brgyad mngon sum du// byed cing de las ma nyams par// 'dod pa'i khams su phyir 'ong byed// lhag mthong zag bcas zag pa med// dang po zhi rags rnam pa dang*// thos bsam sgom byung zag bcas so// zag med 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag kun// yin phyir 'phags pas khams gsum la// chags bral byed tshul cig car ba// zag med bden pa'i rnam can phyir// lhag mthong dngos ni rtog pa dang*// bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i rig par// nges shing rnal 'byor mngon sum nyid// yin phyir zhi lhag zung 'jug kyang*// yin no ci'i phyir zhe na// 'phags pa gsum po'i mnyam gzhag gi

/lhag mthong gang yin zhi gnas dang*// zhi gnas gang yin lhag mthong phyir// mnyam par bzhag na blo med par// 'dod pa'i lugs la zung 'jug tu// 'chad la 'gal ba yod min te// gnyis su med pa nyid phyir ro// gsum tshan drug pa gsang sngags pa// chags sogs gsum dang de re re'ang*// chen por phye nas 'chad byed tshe// khyad par gang gis dbye zhe na// dmigs rnam gang yang mi 'char ba'i// bdag dang chos kyi rmongs pa ni// re shig tshe na sad 'gyur phyir// ma rig pa ni chung du ste// dmigs rnam mtshan ma dang 'brel ba'i// chos dang bdag med ye shes dang*// bde stong zung du 'jug pa ni// 'gyur ba med phyir gti mug che// phal ba'i zhe sdang re shig na// gzhan du 'gyur tshe zhe sdang chung*// rdo rje khro bos bgegs 'joms pa// 'gyur med phyir na zhe sdang che// 'jig rten chags sdang re shig na// chags bral nyid du 'gyur phyir chung*// chags pa thams cad sel byed pa'i// bde chen chags pa cher bshad pas// nam yang ri khrod mar dga' ba// snyoms par zhugs pas rtag zhi ba// thar par zhen pa spangs pas ni// bde chen go 'phang don du bsngo// sngags la 'jug pa'i lam gsum po// gsum tshan drug pa 'di bshad tshe// tshig mang po yis rgyud 'khrug pa'i// bod kyi mkhas rnams zhum byos shig /'phags yul 'khrungs pa'i mngon rlom gyi// rnam par dregs pa de bor la// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo// 'byed pa'i ya mtshan 'di ltos shig /ces theg pa chen por 'jug pa'i lam chen gsum tshan drug pa ces bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di/ yang dag par rtogs nas grub pa'o// shubhaṃ// sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
